r8_turns.rule: one sign where fitted (convex); |turn| < 0.1 deg counts as straight; the top-left arc is kept (stop rule)

r9_turns.rule: one sign where fitted (convex); |turn| < 0.1 deg counts as straight; the top-left arc is kept (stop rule)

r8.rule: no 4-px chord turns more than 2 x the mean of its two neighbours (theta -45 deg .. the bottom arc)

r9.rule: no 4-px chord turns more than 2 x the mean of its two neighbours (theta -45 deg .. the bottom arc)

c_ramp.rule: both flanks within +-0.5 px of the reference

e_halo.rule: <= 10 bright px on the lantern; no dark fringe on the lantern beyond R8's (the cord apart)

stop_rule.top_left_decision: NOT CHANGED (only its ramp): one convex line over the whole left side needs 2.25 px of fill at (1614.8, 216.4), a tier step the model drew on the top-left arc; a fit held to 2 px there flattens the shoulder (a new facet). Per the stop rule: left as it is, the x 2 crop to the designer (crops-r9/pendant-2-top-left-stop-x2.png)

colour_lock.method: data/selections/living-room.warm-modern.json, curtains-cj-japanese-linen-half-shade colour_2026_11_12 (the designer, F3 closed): QA's same mask, CIELAB D65 by QA's formulas, medians; each value rounded half-up to 0.1, ends included; QA's Lab decides, OpenCV is a cross-check
colour_lock.note: R9 changes no pixel in this mask (the 11 are soft-edge pixels): the colour is R8's, C* 12.52 reads 12.5 (on the edge, passes)

records.alpha_unchanged_correction: TRUE for the UNGRADED sources only (work-r8/layers/<name>.png alpha and <name>-free-alpha.png are the R7 bytes). FALSE for the graded layers in layers/: cut() raises a soft-edge alpha where the scene under it changed (soft_edge_alpha_raised), so the graded alpha moved on 7 / 6 / 64 soft-edge pixels (180502 / 554205 / Linen), max 15 / 20 / 12 levels, and on 0 pixels where the source is not soft

shell_lock.rule: every named line p90 <= 9.6 px with >= 20 paired samples (lock_r7.py)
